Create SyntaxList(allocated empty); update with nil. Observe returned identity, counts, original nilness.

VisitNode wrappers with zero children, singleton nil, and singleton nested SyntaxList; capture exact panic payload and nil return.

VisitEachChild(PropertyAccess(expression,token,expression)); observe token hook fallback separately from general node hook.
Source factory creates child Identifier loc(1,6), list loc(0,7), Array loc(0,8); destination factory DeepCloneNode; observe identities/all locations/trailing comma/parent.
Destination DeepCloneReparse(source array); observe retained source positions/parent/REPARSED.

Await(This) inside FunctionExpression and ArrowFunction, then inside ComputedPropertyName; observe own and propagated scope facts.

NewSourceFile(/fixture.ts,text hex78ff,nil,EOF); set loc(0,2),flags7,ScriptKindTS,IdentifierCount3,NodeCount7,TextCount11,Hash(Hi13,Lo17),CheckJsDirective true,ExternalModuleIndicator self,HasLazyJSDoc true.

NewSourceFile(/cache.ts), NewSourceFileDataKey[*int]; first GetOrComputeSourceFileData increments counter and panics "source initializer failed". Capture payload locally.

Install SourceFile create/update/clone hooks. Observe phase, ScriptKind, IdentifierCount/NodeCount/TextCount, hash Hi/Lo, diagnostic count, flags/pos/end, factory counts and filename/text hex at each hook.

On each SourceFile create, observe initialized name/text and zero parser metadata before mutation.
